annotations.title: Score a website for AI-made design habits

description: Fetches a public web page and its main stylesheets and scripts once, then scores it from 0 (hand-made feel) to 100 (certified slop) against 19 design and copy habits that make a site look AI-made (purple gradients, gradient headlines, glow blobs, glassmorphism, default fonts, untouched component kits, icon card grids, buzzwords, template headlines, vague social proof, placeholder testimonials, app-builder leftovers, em dashes and more). Returns each tell found with how to fix it.

url.description: Public website address, for example example.com or https://example.com/pricing

name: slopscore_check_site
